verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents a Skills API (upload/manage skills, create endpoint) and shows Skills invoked programmatically via the Messages API `container` parameter (up to 20 skills per request, skill_id/type/version), giving AI-native users a documented public API path distinct from the Claude Code CLI/UI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of calling this API, and fuller API reference details (auth, rate limits, error handling) beyond the guide snippets.
